state.paragraph: Between July 11, 2013 and July 23, 2013, Party B, Party C and CSC/Pamplona engaged in a preliminary review of Mac-Gray and the potential acquisition opportunity. Also during this time, outside counsel to Party A and representatives of Goodwin Procter negotiated the terms of a confidentiality and standstill agreement, but did not come to agreement on the terms of the customer and employee non-solicitation provisions.

ledger_rows.Note: Refuses rollover partnership: denies the request (relayed by Rothenberg 07/03) for Moab to partner exclusively with CSC/Pamplona on a rollover. Such talks allowed only later.
Agreement with Pamplona Capital Management LLC, reused in the merger agreement (s. 6.17). Received the informational package. Party A's NDA talks stalled on non-solicit terms 07/11-07/23.
Preliminary IOI based only on the informational package, with no data room or management access (Heavy by context).
Written preliminary IOI, one day after the due date. Based on the informational package only (Heavy by context).
Oral preliminary IOI to BofA, one day after the due date. Based on the informational package only (Heavy by context).

nda_access.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a party signs a confidentiality agreement, or is given (or denied) data room access, management meetings, projections or other diligence information. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.

adviser.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a financial or legal adviser is retained, engaged, terminated or first shown acting for the target, a committee or a bidder. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
